book.name: Maluku
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Maluku

content: Bhando bhinkana Yecho ku Nachalete
Yecho ajhakubhoka peniya alongohine na bhabholwa bhake na kujhenda ku muche gwake.

Lichiko lya Kupomolela pulihikita, Yecho akatumbwii kubhola munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude, bhando bhamahele bhibhannyokanikiya bhakahechwike. Bhajhakukonya, “Ghanga ghoha apatite ko? Ichima ghane jhapatite mundo hojho ade atende ilebhe ya kukangacha?
Bho, jhonjo mwana jwa mmacha mibhoko, mwana gwa Maliya na nnongo mundo Yakobu na Uchupo na Yuda na Simone? Bho, akalombo mundo bhabhii pambajhe na twenga?” Peniya bhajhakunchimwa na kunkana.
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Nnondole jwa Chapanga bhanyokanikiya kila chehemo, nambo bhanyokanikiya ndeka pakilambo chake na akalongo bha kajha kwabhe.”
Yecho akatei ndeka ikangacho yoyoha pala, akabhekii mabhoko bhilwalwa bhandina, bhakalamite.
Yecho akakangiche nhwalo bhakibha jhe na kihobholelo. Yecho ituma bhabholwa kome na bhabhele Matei 10:5-15; Luka 9:1-6 Peniya Yecho akajhahwii pachenda jhibhandikii na kubhola bhando.
Akakemite bhabholwa bhake kome na bhabhele, ajhakwatuma bhabhele bhabhele na kwapeke ukindendeke gwa kubhenga michuka.
Peniya ajhakwalobholela, “Pimijhenda nkoto kughegha kilebhe, nnyegha nkongocho. Nkoto kughegha chakulya, amu lihako, amu mbijha.
Uhwale maghubache, nkoto kughegha ngobho henge.
Kabhele ajhakwalobholela nyumba jhojhoha jhipala kujhingila, ntame mwenio ade pupala kubhoka.
Pibhapala kukana kumpoke amu kunnyokanikiya, mmoke peniya na nkung'unde lutukunda lulubhii mumagholo ghino, kulangiya bhakanite lilobhe lya Chapanga!”
Bhahe, bhakajhahwii kutangachii bhando bhauleka uhakaho na bhang'alambukile Chapanga.
Bhakachomwii michuka twe. Bhakapakite mahuta bhibhalwalwa, bhajhakwalamicha.
Kuhwe kwa Yohane Mbatichajhe

Munahota nkolongwa Helode pajhohina malobhe gheniya gha chipwa jha Yecho itapakii. Bhando bhange bhakalongii, “Jhonjo Yohane Mbatichajhe ayokite! Ndi mana likakala lya ikangacho lihenga lihengo nkate jhake.”
Bhange bhalongila, “Jhonjo ndi Eliya.” Na bhange bhalongila, “Jhonjo ndi jhumo jwa bhalondole bha Chapanga ngita milondole bha makacho.”
Nambo Helode pajhohina malobhe, alongila, “Yohane Mbatichajhe nikahekite muto ayokite!,”
Akawachii naha nhwalo machiko gheniya Helode jwenio akalaghalikiye Yohane bhantabhe mukipungo. Akatehi naha nhwalo gwa Helodiya nhwana mundo, jwakibha nhwana mundo Filipu, nnongo mundo Helode.
Machiko gheniya Yohane Mbatichajhe akankonyite Helode, “Chamaha jhe mwenga kuntolela mwikeghe jwa nnongo gwino.”
Bhahe, Helodiya mwikeghe jwa munahota ajhakunchimwa Yohane na kupala kunkoma, nambo akahotwii ndeka.
Helode atehila kunyoghopa Yohane kwa mana akibha mundo jwatehila mambu gha umbone na nyahinyahi, bhahe, ajhakunnyemelela. Apalita kunyokanikiya, pajhomolila kunyokanikiya mwojho uminita hake.
Lichiko limo, mwikeghe jwa munahota Helodiya akapatite pwache jha unyagho gwa kubhelukwa Helode. Helode akabhatendile unyagho akanahota akakomana ngondo na akanahota bha kilambo cha ku Galilaya.
Peniya nchikana jwa Helodiya pajhingila ajhakukina, ajhakuhanganicha Helode na akaghene bhake. Peniya munahota nkolongwa ajhakunnobholela mwana jwenio, “Unyope kilebhe chochoha chimipala, nanimpela.”
Mala jha ubhele akalapanikiye, “Chochoha chimpala, ata nucho jha Unahota gwango.”
Peniya nchikana jhola ajhakubhoka, na kunkonya majhe mundo, “Nyope kilebhe ghane?” Na jwenio ajhakujhanguu, “Muto gwa Yohane Mbatichajhe.”
Nchikana jhola ajhakubhutuka ade kwa munahota nkolongwa, ajhakulonge, “Umbekehe muto gwa Yohane Mbatichajhe mukipalo!”
Munahota Helode ajhakubhehe ngolongondi hake, akahotwii ndeka kukana, nambo nhwalo gwa kilapo chake palonge jha akaghene bhake.
Papalapala akannaghalikiye nkomana ngondo akajhahwii kukipungo, kunheketa muto gwa Yohane,
peniya ajhakuleta muto gwenio mukipalo, ajhakumpekiya nchikana jwenio, na jwenio ajhakukamuha majhe mundo.
Bhabholwa bha Yohane pibhajhohina gheniya, bhajhakutola yegha jhake, bhajhakuchika umambe.
Yecho abhapeke chakulya bhando elufo nhwano
Akatenga bhala bhajhakukelebhuka, bhakakonganike palonge jha Yecho, bhajhakunnobholela gheniya ghoha ghantei na kubhola.
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Tujhende pakiyepela tukapomolele.” Alongila naha nhwalo pakibha na bhando bhamahele bhubhahikita na kubhoka, ade Yecho na bhabholwa bhake bhakapatitejhe pwache jha kulyegha.
Peniya, bhajhakubhoka mungalabha, bhajhakujhenda chehemo jhanga bhando.
Nambo bhando bhamahele bhajhakwabhona pibhabhokita, bhajhakumanya. Peniya bhajhakubhutuka kuhumii ku muche bhakatumbwii kuhika kabula jha Yecho.

Yecho na bhabholwa bhake pibhahulwika mungalabha, ajhakulibhona lilongo likolongwa lya bhando, ajhakwabhone kiya nhwalo bhabhonakina ngita mambelele ghangabhehe na nnuchajhe. Peniya ajhakwatumbuu kwabhola malobhe twe.
Pukihikita kimihe, bhabholwa bhake bhajhakunyende, bhajhakunobholela Yecho, “Pambano tubhii panjenga, na lyobha litipike.
Mwulitabhuke lilongo lya bhando leno bhajhende ku mighonda na chenda ibhandikile, bhakahemele yakulya.”

Nambo Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Mangota mapekehe yakulya.” Bhajhakunkonya, “Bho, twapeke nike? Natupalwa kuhenga lihengo kwa miyehe jhamahele tipate mbijha ya kuhemela ilebhe ya kulyegha bhando bhamba?”
Yecho ajhakwakonya, “Bho nkwete mabumunda maligha? Nnyende mukalinge.” Pubhamanyita, bhajhakunnobholela, “Tukwete mabumunda nhwano tugha na homba ibhele.”
Peniya Yecho ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake, mabhona bhando bhakatamite muibhogha ibhele, pamanyahe mabhehe.
Peniya bhajhakutama ibhoghaibhogha, apa makome kome na pala makome nhwano.

Bhahe, Yecho akatoii mabumunda nhwano na homba ibhele, ajhakulola kunane, ajhakunchenguu Chapanga na ajhakumetula. Ajhakwapekeya bhabholwa bhake bhapeke bhando. Helahela bhajhakwahekete bhando bhoha homba.
Bhando bhoha bhakalile na kujhukuta.
Peniya bhabholwa bhake bhajhakujhola mahighiliko gha homba na mabumunda bhakatweli ichukilo kome na ibhele.
Akanalome bhubhalile bhakibha elufo nhwano.
Yecho ityanga panane jha mache
Peniya ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake bhajhingile mungalabha bhalongolele ku Betisaida kwiye jha lilabha. Jwenio akibha atabhuka ibhogha ya bhando.
Pajhomolila kwatabhuka bhando, ajhakujhenda pakitombe kunyopa Chapanga.
Pukihikita kimihe, ngalabha ikibha pakate jha lilabha na Yecho akibha kanjika chake ndo mupele mwa lilabha.
Akamwene bhabholwa bhake pubhalaghita mungalabha, nhwalo upepo gwatobhita kanonoho. Puibhandikila kuchegha, Yecho ajhakwajhende, akibha atyanga panane jha mache, apata kwapeta.
Nambo bhene pibhamwene ityanga panane jha mache, bhajhakuwacha lihoka, bhajhakulalama.
Bhoha pibhamwene bhajhakujhoghopa hake. Papalapala Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Nkangamale! Ndi nenga. Nkotoka kujhoghopa.”
Peniya ajhakuhobhokela mungalabha jhikibha na bhabholwa bhake, na upepo ujhakuleka. Bhabholwa bhake bhakakangiche hake.
Nhwalo bhakamanyitejhe chakatehii Yecho panane jha libumunda lela, miojho jhabhe ikibha mijhundapaho.
Yecho ilamicha bhibhalwalwa kwenio ku Genechalete
Bhajhakujhomboka lilabha bhajhakuhika ku kilambo cha ku Genechalete, bhajhakujhemeka ngalabha jhabhe.
Pibhapitita mungalabha, papalapala bhando bhajhakummanya Yecho.
Peniya bhajhakutindila kajhombe mukilambo choha, bhajhakutumbuu kwatola bhibhalwalwa mumipacha na kwapeleka popoha pubhajhohina Yecho abhii.

Na kila pajhahwila muchenda, ku miche amu ku mighonda, bhajhakwabheka bhibhalwalwa mu maghuliho. Bhangalwalwa bhajhakumpembelekeya Yecho bhapapae lilombolo lya ngobho jhake, bhoha bhibhakampapiye bhakalamite.
